description: Execute any endpoint (e.g. search.google.web, search.google.news, web.extract.markdown, youtube.video.transcript) and return compact LLM-ready output (-80% context tokens).

endpoint_id.description: Target endpoint ID from search_endpoints, e.g. "search.google.web".

params.description: Endpoint request arguments matching get_endpoint_schema, e.g. {"q":"MCP servers","limit":5}.

name: call_endpoint

data.description: Normalized response object (or compact markdown string when format="md").

meta.description: Execution receipt (request_id, endpoint, cost_usd, tokens_est, cached).
